Artichoke leaf extract (*Cynara scolymus*) `may help support liver health by reducing oxidative stress, stimulating bile secretion, and modestly lowering liver enzymes in certain conditions` . However, it is not a proven standalone treatment for liver disease, and clinical findings across trials vary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXv7cO8DbOis6QkWwOUi568-nEdVrcsXSEgaZBcGDk_Mj1x0ZyHt64R21ynV0lDymL2PzmNcuHSEah1D2k17DiZ9lBD-x2r18rJH_X6P9n8uP2zPTRILtIrurIMk_6ORW7yoarpIhfkjJN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXfeKzMAX7-S7gylVIJvIxRye4GMsUMQn93g7HgPbP3jOKQVkMswVXQcTscdO9_ihnnXcLR5-wRghiFkOvUyT3Lm6jAczRM95SvRPV3YDuxT2dvMrNTmwIA53OmAChHHOi69gNt1vRKDOAOw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXX-edviJhUyAlXTbqOoCNGfCo9XkQ4mxA8IWACC4cdUkJ_iTynkOa1a4e9DF4374-4Ei1R91mSlQuHxQWoLPrFkXldII86q3A-BIQgzE4IuJfkMJE9vo0Npl8ytgf40H5kL6wdoztQ6q4iVei8WU3L)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXT2RUpMJB2W3hDVZJLS53gBEVpmxifVaaTVDsFHAXWy14zPClpwBm-cguSIGFi7sVejPmPPQ3PvfcfRcTbAxnOeFOiPlZPcwDuwzfnLzyzCXC2GjHCCGDLHHlMOczv1WrMKWdHRFpjQJ9Kej8jGJhJQLg3w)

### What the Research Shows

- **Liver enzymes:** A [systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXv7cO8DbOis6QkWwOUi568-nEdVrcsXSEgaZBcGDk_Mj1x0ZyHt64R21ynV0lDymL2PzmNcuHSEah1D2k17DiZ9lBD-x2r18rJH_X6P9n8uP2zPTRILtIrurIMk_6ORW7yoarpIhfkjJN) found reductions in ALT and AST liver enzymes, with stronger AST effects noted at doses above 500 mg and ALT effects in trials lasting 8 weeks or less.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXv7cO8DbOis6QkWwOUi568-nEdVrcsXSEgaZBcGDk_Mj1x0ZyHt64R21ynV0lDymL2PzmNcuHSEah1D2k17DiZ9lBD-x2r18rJH_X6P9n8uP2zPTRILtIrurIMk_6ORW7yoarpIhfkjJN)
- **Fatty liver (NAFLD/MASLD):** A [pilot randomized controlled trial](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXwoLepIWAhAnBmz37bVLWZq6-bJJejvP7Ik6nMTAUhABRdQA5Wdb1ApB3ZF8lr3FgZTMGqUL_gbMsNpg3NXA1LKjLt_GKoyDFJXoU7IZOswmLlGcpyAWwgM-Rb1TwVeXEBQ) using 600 mg of artichoke leaf extract daily for 2 months in adults with NAFLD reported improvements in liver enzymes, bilirubin, lipids, and ultrasound markers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXwoLepIWAhAnBmz37bVLWZq6-bJJejvP7Ik6nMTAUhABRdQA5Wdb1ApB3ZF8lr3FgZTMGqUL_gbMsNpg3NXA1LKjLt_GKoyDFJXoU7IZOswmLlGcpyAWwgM-Rb1TwVeXEBQ)
- **Bile & antioxidant activity:** Compounds like cynarin, chlorogenic acid, and luteolin glycosides provide antioxidant effects and stimulate bile flow, which aids fat digestion and lipid processing. You can review broader evidence grades and safety notes on the [Examine Artichoke Extract page](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXfeKzMAX7-S7gylVIJvIxRye4GMsUMQn93g7HgPbP3jOKQVkMswVXQcTscdO9_ihnnXcLR5-wRghiFkOvUyT3Lm6jAczRM95SvRPV3YDuxT2dvMrNTmwIA53OmAChHHOi69gNt1vRKDOAOw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXv7cO8DbOis6QkWwOUi568-nEdVrcsXSEgaZBcGDk_Mj1x0ZyHt64R21ynV0lDymL2PzmNcuHSEah1D2k17DiZ9lBD-x2r18rJH_X6P9n8uP2zPTRILtIrurIMk_6ORW7yoarpIhfkjJN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXfeKzMAX7-S7gylVIJvIxRye4GMsUMQn93g7HgPbP3jOKQVkMswVXQcTscdO9_ihnnXcLR5-wRghiFkOvUyT3Lm6jAczRM95SvRPV3YDuxT2dvMrNTmwIA53OmAChHHOi69gNt1vRKDOAOw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1xlDKNnPuQVM6aUjMBue14OHYhhUfJPBre8mwSKryR7--zprFLLF3F_B9u-9OrfCjsMU4UCqzQ42dsUSCHYiHeNPNb7Gmb8XySGxFS9iSEp7jGJ7B9s0osyvK67Z1jU76GHj-1QtzRT6sC-5JAnNyR4ytoCQwQwH2r6FWq6LsrSfRS1ut55gTtUEU3VEZpypG66OWA)

### Dosage & Safety Considerations

- **Dosage range:** Human studies commonly use roughly 320 mg to 1,800+ mg per day (with broader study ranges spanning 4.33 to 3,000 mg over 4 to 32 weeks), depending on extract standardization. There is no single established optimal dose.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXfeKzMAX7-S7gylVIJvIxRye4GMsUMQn93g7HgPbP3jOKQVkMswVXQcTscdO9_ihnnXcLR5-wRghiFkOvUyT3Lm6jAczRM95SvRPV3YDuxT2dvMrNTmwIA53OmAChHHOi69gNt1vRKDOAOw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF17CAfWay9-2xTJI3FANpIxS2p11a5iYFUGT7KF3Ut5yVwe6wh3u_fZOnUYZDHBcyosobZ5g-rj-l6SeEeN0-LQaE0QxAdI8oYUnG9Te6azb8_jol8Pdbql4FuBgu1P_wnEt9K2vdmJsTxqEKc6hzIWnOIMVC1nSPQYVH0Xb6GieasfB_OXnL9ZwzrSlXZHS-GLk)
- **Precautions:** Because artichoke stimulates bile secretion, people with **gallstones or bile duct blockages** should avoid it unless cleared by a doctor. Those who are pregnant, nursing, allergic to plants in the Asteraceae/Compositae family, or taking medications should consult a healthcare provider first.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXYwOcwfZkZrdHTpzRtcHjCQvYYeE-j-S31iDVpP3a0ZcOx7zlckrc15Umpxwwqgru8DbS9kJjX8KfEfM5eR3br_XkCQFJyZ1jx5jbdGlulJrvOae90jIH0LgMr_IjavS1i5nf6qx4AsvdmCSsDP5OThyC5ls)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXfeKzMAX7-S7gylVIJvIxRye4GMsUMQn93g7HgPbP3jOKQVkMswVXQcTscdO9_ihnnXcLR5-wRghiFkOvUyT3Lm6jAczRM95SvRPV3YDuxT2dvMrNTmwIA53OmAChHHOi69gNt1vRKDOAOw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXvHfnsWD2qSBVhQyTy5pfFK5lMnqg-t116nLNd54-KEdtLJtP1rDfzJ9OfTUxepzAAmcu_1LE9gJ_bQyfPxZYgAYhWm7CvA_aayM-A7QS0bWX03EFw_hz-Zeo-YMRs7-lgg_enA78PkUK)
